data.review_body:
I ordered five hangers in total for my wedding to be delivered to Greece. Upon arrival, only three out of the five hangers have arrived. 

I have immediately gone to Shein Customer Service where throughout there were no notifications of when agents replied and there were no updates to say that the investigation had been complete and that everything had been accounted for when being packaged. 

This therefore posed the question of where are the two remaining hangers. The service from the customer service team has been disgusting. I have been told on multiple occasions to check the packaging that it came in after it being confirmed that only one package was sent with supposed all items accounted for. I don't know how many more times I can check an empty packet. 

There is still no solution to this as all you can receive is an automated message saying that everything was accounted for at the time of dispatch...
data.review_headline: The case of the missing hangers

Ordered a wallet from Shein...first and last time user...and received the wrong one.
Their customer service line just says they can not take the call and hangs up on you... absolutely no customer service.  I want to return and get my money back but am having a very difficult time doing so.  States I will need a return label....but can't get one.  Never again...a company without customer service is not one I will do business with again.

Update:  I was offered a partial refund...which is not acceptable since I was sent the wrong item....so their reply means nothing...just more runaround.  Only a full refund is acceptable....you do not pay yourself for sending the wrong item.
